title: Amr and Chemistry
statementMd:
Amr loves Chemistry, and specially doing experiments. He is preparing for a new interesting experiment.

Amr has $*n*$ different types of chemicals. Each chemical $*i*$ has an initial volume of $*a*_{*i*}$ liters. For this experiment, Amr has to mix all the chemicals together, but all the chemicals volumes must be equal first. So his task is to make all the chemicals volumes equal.

To do this, Amr can do two different kind of operations.

- Choose some chemical $*i*$ and double its current volume so the new volume will be $2*a*_{*i*}$
- Choose some chemical $*i*$ and divide its volume by two (integer division) so the new volume will be ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/527470887c95577094d0c6c100f6bec4842e6d29.png)

Suppose that each chemical is contained in a vessel of infinite volume. Now Amr wonders what is the minimum number of operations required to make all the chemicals volumes equal?

## Input

The first line contains one number $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$), the number of chemicals.

The second line contains $*n*$ space separated integers $*a*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5}$), representing the initial volume of the $*i*$-th chemical in liters.

## Output

Output one integer the minimum number of operations required to make all the chemicals volumes equal.

## Note

In the first sample test, the optimal solution is to divide the second chemical volume by two, and multiply the third chemical volume by two to make all the volumes equal $4$.

In the second sample test, the optimal solution is to divide the first chemical volume by two, and divide the second and the third chemical volumes by two twice to make all the volumes equal $1$.
statementZhMd:
Amr 热爱化学，尤其喜欢做实验。他正在准备一个有趣的新实验。

Amr 有 $*n*$ 种不同的化学品。每种化学品 $*i*$ 的初始体积为 $*a*_{*i*}$ 升。在这个实验中，Amr 必须将所有化学品混合在一起，但首先必须使所有化学品的体积相等。因此，他需要使所有化学品的体积相等。

为此，Amr 可以进行以下两种操作：

- 选择某种化学品 $*i*$，将其当前体积翻倍，使新体积变为 $2*a*_{*i*}$；
- 选择某种化学品 $*i*$，将其体积除以二（整除），使新体积变为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/527470887c95577094d0c6c100f6bec4842e6d29.png)。

假设每种化学品都装在一个无限容量的容器中。现在 Amr 想知道，使所有化学品的体积相等所需的最少操作次数是多少？

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$），表示化学品的种类数。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个用空格分隔的整数 $*a*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5}$），表示第 $*i*$ 种化学品的初始体积（单位：升）。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，表示使所有化学品的体积相等所需的最少操作次数。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，最优方案是将第二种化学品的体积除以二，并将第三种化学品的体积翻倍，使所有化学品的体积都变为 $4$。

在第二个样例中，最优方案是将第一种化学品的体积除以二，并将第二种和第三种化学品的体积各除以二两次，使所有化学品的体积都变为 $1$。
